$comment: Root ADR-0280 §4, ADR-0401 §1. The data.go.kr file data the platform collects: where each file is asked for, what it must look like, how its rows are keyed and how they reach a parcel or a 법정동. The collector (`collect-data-go-kr-file-data` in services/foundation-outbox-publisher) iterates `files` (keyed by dataset_slug, the catalog's), the Silver loads and their tests read this file; nothing else restates these values. One run asks each selected file's metadata once and fetches a file only when its atchFileId is new. The per-run cap is the files themselves: measured 2026-11-04, the eight files beside the registered factory are about 15.5 MB together plus the 349 MB 상가(상권) zip (59 s), so a run that finds every one new lands about 365 MB in about 3 minutes with the spacing. The three 표준데이터 (school location, university, subway station) have no portal file id: they come through the dataset page's own keyless download (`standard_download` below, root ADR-0452), every page of one pass in one gzip JSON-lines object, landed only when the pass's rows differ from the last landed pass; the OpenAPI is only a cross-check when the platform's key is registered.
user_agent: foundation-platform-data-go-kr-file-collector/3 (+root ADR-0280, ADR-0401, ADR-0452; one check per file per day)

metadata.$comment: The portal's own two steps: the metadata answer names the current file (atchFileId), then the file is fetched by that id. A new atchFileId is a new edition; the same one is never fetched twice.

standard_download.$comment: Root ADR-0452. The keyless download every 표준데이터 page (data.go.kr/data/<pk>/standard.do) offers as CSV/JSON/XLS: the page's own script (std-download-manager.js) asks `columns_path` for the current table (svcTableNm, its column list colNmList, the row count totalCount, the column codes and names) and then `rows_path` for the rows, page by page, as a JSON array keyed by column code. A run asks both every time, so a provider's new table or column is seen on the run after it changes; nothing here or in a state file names the table. Measured 2026-11-09: the three answer 12,004, 1,995 and 898 rows, every row the column list plus instt_code/instt_nm; page_size 10,000 is the page script's own perPage.

openapi.$comment: The 표준데이터 OpenAPI (api.data.go.kr/openapi/tn_pubr_*), a cross-check only (root ADR-0452): when DATA_GO_KR_SERVICE_KEY (config/runtime-secrets.contract.json data-go-kr; never written here, into Bronze or a log) is set, a run that lands a new pass asks the file's operation for one row and records in the manifest whether the total it reports is the pass's row count. A missing key or the gateway's refusal (2026-11-04: SERVICE_KEY_IS_NOT_REGISTERED_ERROR, HTTP 403, for each of the three) is recorded and never fails the file. The answer is read like the Onbid collector's (header.resultCode 00 rows, 03 nothing).

member.$comment: The data member of the zip: the CSV whose name ends with _<기준일 YYYYMMDD>.csv. The dictionary members beside it are not data.

bounds.$comment: A refused file loads nothing. min_rows is the first edition's floor (220,705 measured, minus about 10%); max_shrink_share refuses an edition smaller than the last loaded one by more than this share.

silver_load.$comment: What one Silver load may take (plan-silver-load-objects): zips of this source that no commit of silver.registered_factory records, landed within window_days, oldest first, one per run (each is a whole edition). The window stays shorter than the snapshot retention (lakehouse-maintenance.contract.json retain_days, refused otherwise): an expired snapshot takes its load record with it.

pnu_resolution.$comment: ADR-0280 §4. The provider gives no PNU. A row's address is read as a jibun address or a road address; each step names itself in pnu_basis, and a row no step resolves keeps pnu null with pnu_unresolved_reason. Never by geometry. jibun_address: 시도·시군구·읍면동(·리) names match reference.legal_dong_code_snapshot's current full_name, plus 산 and 본번-부번, and the PNU must be a current row of silver.parcel_boundaries. road_address: 시도·시군구·도로명·건물번호 match silver.building_register_titles.road_address_raw read the same way, and every matching title must carry the same pnu. A sample of 2,829 road addresses on 2026-10-19 resolved 82.9% to one PNU, 4.7% to several, 12.4% to none.
pnu_resolution.sido_prefixes_from: address_pnu.sido_prefixes: the 법정동 code table (reference.legal_dong_code_snapshot, every status) and the recorded 시도 pairs (legal_dong_code_change_views.region_pairs), read each load; no 시도 code is written here (root ADR-0403, ADR-0103 §2)
